title_en: Apartment 1+1 for sale at Viva Complex!
description_en: We offer for sale a 1+1 apartment in Viva Complex! Property specifications: Floor 4 residential New complex under construction Elevator Net surface area 60.7 m2 Gross surface area 72.2 m2 Regular floor plan Orientation North East The apartment is organized in: Living room, bedroom, balcony and bathroom For the purchase of the apartment payment by INSTALLMENT is also offered: 50% of the value upon signing the contract and 2 other installments of 25% provided that liquidated within 6 months. A very good investment opportunity, both for living and renting. The area offers a high potential for increasing the value of the property over time. Contact me for a visit to the property!
